description: This file manages the staging and linking of plugin runtime files and their dependencies, including creating symbolic links, copying specific files, and wrapping JavaScript modules for a plugin system in a build or deployment process.

methods.name: symlinkType
methods.description: Returns the type of symbolic link to create based on the platform ('junction' for Windows, 'dir' for others).

methods.name: relativeSymlinkTarget
methods.description: Calculates the relative path from the target location to the source path.

methods.name: ensureSymlink
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link if it doesn't exist or matches the expected target, recreates it otherwise.

methods.name: symlinkPath
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link from sourcePath to targetPath of specified type.

methods.name: shouldWrapRuntimeJsFile
methods.description: Determines if a file should be wrapped as a module based on its extension (.js).

methods.name: shouldCopyRuntimeFile
methods.description: Checks if a file is one of the specific configuration files that should be copied directly.

methods.name: writeRuntimeModuleWrapper
methods.description: Wraps a JavaScript file into a module exporting/importing, and writes it to the target path.

methods.name: stagePluginRuntimeOverlay
methods.description: Recursively stages plugin files from source to target directory, wrapping or copying files as needed.

methods.name: linkPluginNodeModules
methods.description: Creates a symbolic link to the plugin's node_modules directory in the runtime plugin directory.

methods.name: stageBundledPluginRuntime
methods.description: Main function to stage the plugin runtime, organizing extensions, linking node modules, and clean-up.
